possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Training data includes anthracite-org datasets with opaque names and no stated collection/verification details, so traceability of data origin and usage terms is not established.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card lists dataset names but does not document how data was collected, curated, or used, limiting ability to explain model behavior.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides architecture and fine-tune base but no evaluation results, training details beyond epochs/hardware, or inner-workings insights.

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight full-parameter fine-tune of Mistral-Small-Instruct-2409 with 'other' license and no documentation of data rights or governance makes responsibility hard to establish.

specifications.model_size: 41.4 GiB of safetensors weights (44,494,624,536 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a full-parameter fine-tune of Mistral-Small-Instruct-2409, trained for 2 epochs on 8xH100 GPUs provided by Recursal AI / Featherless AI.
training_context.training_data: This model is a fine-tune of Mistral-Small-Instruct-2409, trained on a set of anthracite-org datasets including c2_logs_32k_mistral-v3_v1.2_no_system, kalo-opus-instruct-22k-no-refusal-no-system, kalo-opus-instruct-3k-filtered-no-system, nopm_claude_writing_fixed, and kalo_opus_misc_240827_no_system.
